title: all-hands-march-2026-talking-points-and-qa-draft
content:
Purpose: quick draft for March all-hands. Aim = 20-25 min exec update + 10-15 min Q&A. Lightweight, high signal for org. This is a working doc - lots of TODOs and rough phrasing below.

Top-level messages (elevator):
- We delivered predictable, low-latency inference at scale for more customers this quarter; focus on reliability and cost-efficiency is paying off.
- Product expansion: Dedicated and Private adoption growing; Hosted API remains a key funnel.
- Roadmap: invest in observability + Optimize tooling to drive unit cost improvements and faster troubleshooting.
- People: hiring roadmap + support for cross-team collaboration as capacity scales.

Agenda (20-25m):
1) Quick wins & numbers (3-4m) - CEO or CRO
2) Product updates (6-8m) - VP Product
   - Hosted API: new streaming + function-calling improvements rolled out to prod; early SLA telemetry looks good.
   - Dedicated: two new customers onboarded this quarter (confidential until contracts signed) - improved autoscaling policy reduces tail latency.
   - Private: pilot with regulated customer completed; feedback: KMS integration + audit logs were major unblockers.
3) Reliability & ops (4-5m) - SRE lead
   - Latency P50/P95 improvements vs prior quarter; KV cache and batching changes reduced per-token cost by ~12% in benchmarks.
   - Incident recap: Feb 12 partial outage - root cause = scheduler bug; mitigation: backport patch + rollout policy updates.
4) Roadmap highlights (3-4m) - Eng/Product
   - Optimize: quantization recommendation engine beta; aim for GA in Q3.
   - Observability: token-level cost attribution MVP by end of Q2.
5) People & Hiring (2m) - People Ops
   - Hiring priorities: runtime engineers, SRE, product managers for Private.

Talking points (more granular, for each speaker):
- CEO (opening): thank the org, two big wins (customer momentum + SLA progress), frame top-level priorities for next 90 days: reliability, unit cost, private deployments. Quick shoutouts to teams: serving-runtime, infra, product.
- VP Product: focus on feature milestones, mention model catalog improvements and function calling rollout. Call out roadmap tradeoffs (speed vs cost) and how Optimize informs decisions.
- SRE lead: be candid about Feb incident, what we fixed, and why this reduces recurrence risk. Also highlight monitoring improvements and on-call changes.
- People Ops: quick hiring ask + reminder about the engineering offsite in May.

Q&A (anticipated questions + suggested answers):
Q: How is ARR trending and are we on track for the target?
A: ARR growth is positive; we crossed $X M in committed ARR from Dedicated this quarter (use exact number in final). Hosted API usage growth steady; need to convert higher-usage customers to Dedicated/Private for predictable revenue. (Follow-up: refer to finance deck for details.)

Q: What happened on Feb 12 outage? Will it happen again?
A: Root cause = scheduler race condition triggered under a specific autoscale pattern. We've backported fixes, improved canarying, and added additional alerting. Residual risk minimal but we'll keep a postmortem action list and track via SRE OKRs.

Q: Any updates on pricing or cost reductions for customers?
A: Not announcing pricing changes at all-hands. We are launching Optimize tooling to give customers more levers (batching, quant profiles) to reduce their unit costs - will highlight case studies in customer newsletter.

Q: Private deployment readiness for regulated customers?
A: Pilot completed; KMS/HSM integration + audit logging validated. Next steps: packaging for on-prem install and hardened network playbooks - target private GA timeline in Q3.

Q: Hiring - when will new roles be posted?
A: Roles opening in next 2-4 weeks (runtime, SRE, PM for Private). People Ops will share hiring tracker + interview rubrics.

Notes to self / TODOs before final copy:
- Get exact ARR number from finance (Carlos) - placeholder X M used above.
- Confirm names of new Dedicated customers (legal sign-off) - Jordan to confirm.
- Replace technical metric placeholders with up-to-date P50/P95 numbers from observability team (Maya).
- Add 2-3 customer quotes (marketing) for slides.
- Finalize speaker order and slide owners - create run-of-show doc.
- Heads-up to engineering managers: prepare one 30s highlight per team for shoutouts.

Slide notes / run-of-show rough:
- Slide 1: Title + logistics (Priya)
- Slide 2: Top lines + metrics (CEO)
- Slide 3: Product highlights (VP Product)
- Slide 4: Reliability recap (SRE lead)
- Slide 5: Roadmap (Eng/Product)
- Slide 6: People & hiring (People Ops)
- Slide 7: Q&A (panel)

Open items / risks:
- Need legal approval before naming customers on slide.
- Ensure Finance comfortable with headline ARR number and public messaging.
- Timeboxing: plan 2 rehearsals next week to keep within 35 minutes including Q&A.

Tone guidance for speakers: upbeat, candid, concrete. Avoid speculative commitments. If asked for timelines, give ranges (e.g., Q2/Q3) not fixed dates unless cross-functional alignment done.

Misc misc (scratchpad):
- Consider a 1-slide customer success vignette (30s) to humanize impact.
- Quick poll idea: live Menti question about top 1 thing folks want to focus on next quarter - helpful for PM sync.
- Add short reminder about Slack etiquette: post follow-ups to #all-hands-questions so we can triage.

Versioning / publishing plan:
- Final draft by March 6 for speaker review.
- Slides + run-of-show by March 8.
- Rehearsal March 10.

-- end draft --

(Working notes / scratch: lots of shorthand here. Will clean and convert into slides once numbers confirmed.)
